name: Haebangchon Night Walk – Huam-dong → Sinheung Market → Sowol-ro → Seoul City Wall → Baekbeom Square
desc: A 2.4 km evening walk through Haebangchon, Seoul: the 108 Stairs elevator, the hilltop Sinheung Market, rooftop viewpoints on Sowol-ro and the Seoul City Wall trail down to Baekbeom Square. Street geometry from OpenStreetMap; segments marked approx are not mapped in any public dataset.

segments.label: Huam-dong bus terminus → foot of the 108 Stairs
Sinheung-ro uphill along the market wall → Haebangchon Ogeori
Sowol-ro 20-gil downhill (east wall of the market)
Mega Coffee → Yunjudang / Mersin Kebab → Ogeori
Sowol-ro sidewalk → Comfort Seoul → Namsan Library
Seoul City Wall trail → Baekbeom Square

waypoints.name: 1. Start – Huam-dong bus terminus (후암동 종점)
waypoints.desc: Last stop of village bus Yongsan 02. Walk 60 m south on Sinheung-ro, then take the alley on the left (Sinheung-ro 22ga-gil).
waypoints.label: Start

waypoints.name: 2. 108 Stairs funicular (inclined elevator) – bottom (108계단 경사형 승강기)
waypoints.desc: A funicular-style inclined elevator runs beside the 108 steps. Ride it or climb; both end at the same spot.
waypoints.label: 108 Stairs funicular

waypoints.name: 3. Top of the 108 Stairs – Gyeongseong Hoguk Shrine sign & Sungsil School site
waypoints.desc: Plaque explains the stairs were the approach to a Japanese war shrine (1943). A stone nearby lists independence activists from Sungsil School (stone position approximate).
waypoints.label: Top of 108 Stairs

waypoints.name: 4. Join Sinheung-ro (village-bus road)
waypoints.desc: From here climb Sinheung-ro toward the hilltop. Narrow road, watch for the Yongsan 02 bus.
waypoints.label: Join Sinheung-ro

waypoints.name: 5. Sinheung Market main gate – do NOT enter here (신흥시장 정문)
waypoints.desc: The classic photo spot with the market sign. Walk past it and circle the market first.
waypoints.label: Market main gate (don't enter)

waypoints.name: 6. Haebangchon Ogeori five-way junction (해방촌오거리)
waypoints.desc: Left leads up to Namsan, right down to Noksapyeong. Cross to the right and walk down Sowol-ro 20-gil.
waypoints.label: Haebangchon 5-way junction

waypoints.name: 7. Hidden market entrance – ‘Damoa Sikdang’ sign, opposite Haebang Church
waypoints.desc: At the corner with the Coca-Cola sign turn right, go down the stairs and immediately turn right into the market.
waypoints.label: (hidden) market entrance

waypoints.name: 8. Inside Sinheung Market (ETFE-roofed alleys)
waypoints.desc: Loop through the alleys under the transparent roof. Step out briefly through the main gate and come back in.
waypoints.label: Inside Sinheung Market

waypoints.name: 9. Market exit at Mega Coffee (Sowol-ro 20-gil 23)
waypoints.desc: Leave the market on the east side and turn right.
waypoints.label: Market exit (Mega Coffee)

waypoints.name: 10. Haebangchon Yunjudang (Sinheung-ro 81-1) & Mersin Kebab (Sinheung-ro 84)
waypoints.desc: Small corner alley. Then head back up to the five-way junction.
waypoints.label: Yunjudang / Mersin Kebab

waypoints.name: 11. Alley between 7-Eleven and the lottery shop
waypoints.desc: Take Sinheung-ro 20-gil between the two shops; it climbs north-west with the valley opening on your left.
waypoints.label: 7-Eleven alley

waypoints.name: 12. The Cliff / Urban Cliff rooftop bar (Duteopbawi-ro 38-gil 29-17)
waypoints.desc: View opens up here. Take the stairs on the right up to Sowol-ro (stair position approximate).
waypoints.label: The Cliff rooftop

waypoints.name: 13. Sowol-ro viewpoint (Soyo rest area)
waypoints.desc: Look down to the left: the Cliff rooftop and the Seoul skyline. Best at dusk.
waypoints.label: Sowol-ro viewpoint

waypoints.name: 14. Comfort Seoul rooftop terrace (Duteopbawi-ro 60-gil 45)
waypoints.desc: The road is at rooftop level here; the café floors are below. Open view over Seoul.
waypoints.label: Comfort Seoul rooftop

waypoints.name: 15. Namsan Public Library – cross Sowol-ro
waypoints.desc: Cross the road, pass the Kim Sowol poem stone and enter the Seoul City Wall trail.
waypoints.label: Cross at Namsan Library

waypoints.name: 16. Seoul City Wall trail (Hanyangdoseong) by the wall exhibition hall
waypoints.desc: Namsan Tower on the right, the old city wall on the left. Inside the wall was old Seoul; Huam-dong outside.
waypoints.label: Seoul City Wall trail

waypoints.name: 17. Finish – Baekbeom Square, statue of Kim Koo (백범광장)
waypoints.desc: Statue of independence leader Kim Koo. The lit wall path continues up Namsan from here.
waypoints.label: End
